text: তনুপে অ্যাপ থেকে পানির বিল বা গ্যাস বিল দিলে ৩০ টাকা ইনস্ট্যান্ট ক্যাশব্যাক।

text: আকাশনেটে ৪৯ টাকায় ২ জিবি ইন্টারনেট ৭ দিন মেয়াদে, ডায়াল করুন *১২১*৬২#।

review_rationale: Label (Promotional), AkashNet metadata, natural Bengali phrasing, and realistic Bengali-digit USSD (*১২১*৬২#) are valid, but the brand+slot-masked template ('<brand> <N> টাকায় <N> জিবি ইন্টারনেট <N> দিন মেয়াদে, ডায়াল করুন <ussd>।') has bslot_cos=0.616 >= 0.60 against Batch 1 syn_b1_0034 and bslot_cos=0.601 >= 0.60 against Batch 2 syn_b2_0034.

text: নতুন 4G router ও pocket Wi-Fi কিনলে প্রথম মাসে 30GB bonus data পাবেন, ডায়াল করুন *৫৬৬*৪১#।

text: আজই শেষ দিন: 5G ready eSIM switch করলে বা নতুন connection নিলে 10GB welcome net আর 150 মিনিট talktime একদম ফ্রি থাকছে, ভিজিট করুন https://example.org/esim
label_rationale: CodeMix brandless urgent eSIM welcome data and talktime offer with reserved URL.
review_rationale: Label (Promotional), CodeMix telecom phrasing, reserved URL (https://example.org/esim), and brandless metadata (brand=null) are intended as brandless, but running detect_brand_mentions and mask_text_views with collect_brand_aliases + batch6_50/brand_registry.json falsely tags the Bengali colon-opener 'আজই শেষ দিন:' as a dynamic brand (['আজই শেষ দিন'] -> '<BRAND>: 5G ready eSIM...') because it is not in _COLON_OPENER_STOPWORDS.

text: 99 takay 7GB internet ar 100 minute 7 diner jonno.
label_rationale: Banglish brandless weekly 7GB and talktime offer.
review_rationale: Near-duplicate slot template of Batch 5 syn_b5_0020 ('95 minute local talktime matro 58 takay 7 diner jonno.', bslot_cos=0.612 >= 0.60, raw_cos=0.494) in the identical (Banglish, telecom, medium(50-120), brandless) stratum, and consists of a bare verbless noun phrase lacking any finite verb or CTA (e.g., 'paben'/'nin'/'dial korun').

text: AkashNet-e 68 takay 140 local minute 15 din meyad, dial *121*36#.

review_rationale: Near-duplicate slot-template clone of Batch 3 syn_b3_r_0001 ('Shudhu 129 takay 210 local minute 15 din meyad, activate korte *566*33# dial korun.', bslot_cos=0.690 >= 0.60 on char_wb and 0.643 on char), repeating the identical '<N> takay <N> local minute <N> din meyad' + USSD frame and dropping the locative '-e' in '15 din meyad' (matching rejected syn_b4_0019).

text: Ajkei last day: 39 takay 2.5GB internet, nite example.org/flash25
label_rationale: Banglish brandless urgent 2.5GB data offer with reserved URL.
review_rationale: Label (Promotional), Banglish telecom domain, and reserved URL (example.org/flash25) are valid, but the clipped CTA ', nite example.org/flash25' omits the required finite CTA verb ('dekhun' / 'visit korun') after the Bengali infinitive 'nite' before the bare URL (matching rejected missing-CTA-verb patterns in syn_b4_0044 and syn_b5_0003).
